methodology.title: Methodology
methodology.subtitle: How the result is calculated
methodology.formulaText: For each layer, Monbo measures how much of the polygon's area coincides with the layer's pixels.
methodology.formulaNumerator: Area of the polygon that coincides with the layer
methodology.findingAvoid: In a category to avoid (for example, deforestation or protected areas), the finding is the part of the polygon that coincides with the layer.
methodology.findingRequired: In a category to comply with (for example, the agricultural frontier), the finding is the part of the polygon that does not coincide with the layer.
methodology.thresholdText: A polygon has findings in a layer when its finding is above the category's threshold. Otherwise, the category's result without findings is shown.
methodology.noDataText: “No data” means that the result could not be calculated, for example because the polygon lies outside the layer's coverage. A result with no data never counts as without findings.
methodology.noCategoryText: This layer's category is no longer available: its results are shown as “No data”.
